_comment: COPY to .production-authorization.json and fill in. That file is gitignored and must never be committed. Every field is required; the release script refuses on any missing or altered field.
authorizedBy: name and role of the person authorizing this release
authorizedAt: ISO-8601 timestamp — the script refuses an authorization older than 24h
databaseTarget: where production PostgreSQL lives for this release, e.g. 'Cloud SQL instance homigo-prod' or 'existing VM postgres 5433'
ledgerDecisionBy: who decided what happens to the 14 CREDITED fixture earnings (Rs.6,286.40)
statement: I authorize this production release and accept responsibility for the migrations listed above.
